$comment: [[D-TOK-STRING-STYLE-MULTILINE-IS-NEVER-READ]] + [[D-PP-CONVERSION-DIAGNOSTIC-FIRES-ON-A-TOKEN-NEVER-CONVERTED]] runtime witness. A lone apostrophe or double quote in text phase 7 never converts — a skipped group's prose, a skipped #error / #warning / unclosed #include <, an unexpanded #define, the words of a live #warning — must neither swallow the lines after it nor be judged. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-22: gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3 and MinGW gcc accept this translation unit (MSVC VS 18 errors on the #define and the live #warning; one working reference makes acceptance required). Before the fix DSS refused it: the first lone quote opened a character constant that ran to the next quote lines later.
$commentWhyNotVacuous: Every line in a skipped group is a line the old lexer broke, so a regression leaves NO ARTIFACT and the harness fails on the build, not on a comparison. The live #warning is pinned by expectWarnings at its own line: a lexer that ran its `'` on would move or lose it. The live arithmetic returns 42 only if the `#if 1` arm was kept.

expectWarnings.$comment: `#warning don't panic: …` — live, so it warns; its lone quote is never converted, so it is not judged
